name: Canal Capital
body: A content security policy, one-year HSTS, nosniff, Permissions-Policy, a canonical, and structured data. But the home page HTML alone weighs 624 KB before any image or script, and it sends no cache-control header.
lesson: Move inline scripts and styles into cached files, and trim long lists.
summary: www.canalcapital.gov.co scores 85 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 20 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 161 images have no width or height.

fix.title: 161 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: 10 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /institucional/, /institucional/11-atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/, /institucional/6-participa/, /institucional/1-informacion-de-la-entidad/1-11-calendario-de-actividades/1-11-2-calendario-de-actividades/parrilla/ and 6 more. Google and AI answers then…
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 43/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 12.0 s, Total Blocking Time 1076 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.066, Speed Index 5.6 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:image
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: 8 internal links go through a redirect
fix.fix: Point the links straight at the final address.

fix.title: 6 script hosts are loaded without integrity checks
fix.evidence: static.addtoany.com, pagead2.googlesyndication.com, s3.amazonaws.com, code.jivosite.com and 2 more. If that CDN is compromised, its code runs on the site.
fix.fix: Add integrity="sha384-…" and crossorigin="anonymous" to fixed-version CDN scripts.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
